text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Phew… Alright. 
My last goal… Until the end,
I need to… Stay motivated!

Cheval Grand was earnestly and tirelessly
completing her training menu for the day.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
…I'm such a scaredy cat… 
How could I ever become the greatest uma
musume…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the beginning,
I-I've never been good at anything! 
…Me getting in here was nothing more than
a fluke, so that's why——

Looking back,
she has changed a lot since then. Back then,
she'd consult me nervously and timidly,
but now—

text_block_list.name: Stern Faced Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Not bad at all.
Although I think tomorrow I'll draw up a
slightly different menu for you.

text_block_list.name: An Honest Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please wait a second. Before you go,
I'd like to ask you something.
I feel as though I still lack action plans
for some situations… So I'd…

…I don't think she's at that level just yet,
but compared to before she's a lot less
reserved when it comes to asking for advice
or asking a question.

I feel as though my assigned uma musume is
slowly, but surely,
improving.
I feel warm on the inside with that thought
in mind.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer? 
…Um, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-is it perhaps, my running? 
D-did I mess up my form??
Did I not follow the menu correctly?

Even when you gave up your precious time to
make it… I'm sorry!
I'll work even harder than before!
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-but it is!
There's still so much that I can't do,
of course there are things worrying me,
that's why…

After I calmed down the panicking Cheval,
I told her I was just remembering the time
when we first met.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …I… see.

(Even if they say they were just recalling
the moment when we first met,
I still feel as though there's something
troubling them…)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That has to be it… In the first place,
they weren't recalling anything… They
were…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(At that time,
they saw something… something about another
uma musume who was training.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That girl was, like everyone else,
was talking with her trainer perfectly
fine…)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Ah!? I-it has to be…

(That girl looked dead set on her goals,
and was overflowing with motivation… Trainer
must've noticed how she was able to convey
her opinions in a straightforward manner.)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Then they must've compared to how much I
haven't changed and thought… I'm extremely
pathetic!?

(They're someone who is able to find the
strong points of people,
even in someone like me—)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand

text_block_list.text:
(…I accepted my invitation after I chose them.
It's obvious that someone like me is nothing
more than a waste of time for them!)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand

text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
won't they… get fed up with me?
The me that can't take that first step? No,
something like that… can't…
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand

text_block_list.text:
(…They might just be putting up with me,
just because they're nice…)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand

text_block_list.text: (What do I do? What can I do?…Uuuu…)
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm so confused… a-anyways… 
I need to work harder than before,
before they get fed up with me.

After all they are… 
My one chance… my only hope!
text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
